title: Dosa Flip Flip | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Dosu the dosa loves to dance, flip, and fly high in the air, but Amma is always there to catch him!
This happy song teaches little ones about sharing, family love, and the joy of a yummy meal together.
Sing along and dance with Dosu every time!

Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle, on the dosa pan
golden colour, nice and hot, so round and round
"I want to see the world!" says Dosu, wiggling about
going up and down, going up and down!

Dosa, dosa, crispy crunchy, crispy crunch
chur, chur, chur, don't you slip
flip, flip, flip, flip
Dosu's dancing, dancing, oh what a trip!

Whoosh, up he goes, so very high, so very, very high
Dosu's flying way up in the air
Amma, Amma, catch me, quick!
Plop! The ladle catches him, all safe and sound!

Dosa, dosa, crispy crunchy, crispy crunch
chur, chur, chur, don't you slip
flip, flip, flip, flip
Dosu's dancing, dancing, oh what a trip!

Big brother shouts out loud, "Hooray, hooray!"
little sister claps her hands
roll, roll, roll me up, says Dosu
with aloo, I'm a crispy roll!

Dosa, dosa, crispy crunchy, crispy crunch
chur, chur, chur, don't you slip
flip, flip, flip, flip
Dosu's dancing, dancing, oh what a trip!

Dip, dip, dip it in the yummy chutney green
Amma serves a plate for everyone at home
yum, yum, yum, yum, everyone eats
big, big smiles, the story ends! Dosa, dosa, call everyone!
